text:
Hi, I’m Noor Halden, and I’d love to help with your long-term content and operations workflow.

I’m a machine learning and Python developer with 6 years of experience, and I’m comfortable working with tools and processes that combine automation, content, and fast execution. Your need for someone who can pick up new systems quickly, communicate clearly in English, and stay reliable across repeated daily tasks is exactly the kind of environment I work well in.

I’ve built practical AI workflows and production support tools, including a Delivery support chatbot for Parcelwise Logistics. That project used Python, OpenAI API, LangGraph, FastAPI, Redis, and Twilio to create a WhatsApp and SMS assistant that tracks parcels, reschedules deliveries, and hands off to a human with full context. It resolved 43% of conversations without an agent and achieved a CSAT of 4.4 out of 5. That experience taught me how to work carefully with prompts, structured outputs, human handoff, and real-world process consistency—skills that translate well to AI content creation and content operations.

For your role, I can help with AI-assisted content creation, Grammarly-style proofreading, image generation support, Canva editing tasks, HubSpot blog publishing, and preparing social posts for LinkedIn and Twitter. I’m used to following processes closely, keeping details organized, and handling repetitive work without losing quality. I also understand the importance of clear communication when working on a long-term support role like this, especially when multiple content steps need to stay aligned.

While my background is technical, I’m comfortable working across content-related workflows and using AI tools in a practical way. I can adapt quickly to your preferred process, help keep production moving, and support the team with dependable execution.

If you’d like, I’d be happy to discuss how I can fit into your existing workflow and help keep content moving smoothly week after week.
